description: Living atom logo with deep cosmic palette. Three electrons travel along the actual elliptical orbital trails drawn in the SVG, using SVG animateMotion with mpath references to hidden arc-path definitions. Each orbit is a tilted ellipse (semi-major a=1093.11, semi-minor b=244.34, centered at 1250,1250): Electron A on the 150°-tilted orbit, B on the 30°-tilted orbit, C on the 90°-tilted (vertical) orbit. Starting positions match the original static electron placements within 35px. Independent drift timings (drift-electron-a/b/c) give each electron its own majestic pace. rotate='none' keeps electrons upright at all times. All original geometry and proportions preserved.

palette_groups.note: Deep space indigo/black tones. bg-outer is the full-bleed circle; bg-inner is the darker void that the orbital trails pass through.
Metallic slate-blue diagonal gradient for the three stylized orbital path shapes. base anchors stop-0%, highlight anchors stop-100%.
Cool metallic silver-cyan shared by the central nucleus and all three electrons. Tight entropy — all four elements should read as the same material.

motion_groups.note: Independent orbital periods for the three electrons. Each uses animateMotion with an mpath reference to its pre-computed arc path. All three orbits are geometrically identical ellipses (a=1093.11, b=244.34) at different tilts — only the duration differs. Longer = more majestic. Keep values clearly different so the three electrons are never in sync.

vars.name: color-bg-outer
vars.note: Full-bleed outer circle. Deep space indigo-black.

vars.name: color-bg-inner
vars.note: Inner void circle (r=725.31). Slightly darker than bg-outer for depth layering.

vars.name: color-orbit-base
vars.note: Gradient stop 0% for all three orbital trail paths. Darker metallic slate.

vars.name: color-orbit-highlight
vars.note: Gradient stop 100% for orbital trails. Lighter metallic blue-white.

vars.name: color-nucleus
vars.note: Central nucleus circle (r=128.6). Same material palette as electrons.

vars.name: color-electron
vars.note: All three electrons share this color. Palette-anchored to nucleus group — they read as the same particle material.
